FIELDS.NAME: Artistry Haven
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Art Lane, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001-0001
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artistry Haven operates as a premier art gallery and supply store, dedicated to fostering creativity and artistic expression in our community. We curate a carefully selected inventory of original artworks from local and emerging artists, ensuring that each piece is valued appropriately for both sales and insurance purposes. Our art supply section features a wide range of materials, from basic tools to specialized items, all managed through stringent inventory practices to prevent loss and ensure compliance with industry standards. We also prioritize the safety of our inventory and customers by maintaining robust fire and water protection systems, including sprinklers and humidity controls. In addition to our retail operations, we regularly host exhibitions, workshops, and community events with comprehensive risk management plans. Our commitment to customer service is highlighted by regular staff training focused on product knowledge, safety practices, and loss prevention. Furthermore, we adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations to ensure a compliant and safe environment for all our patrons.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Artistry Haven Creative Spaces, LLC - A gallery space that hosts art workshops and community engagement events, focusing on artistic development and expression.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 5, 2023, a burst pipe caused water damage to part of our gallery, resulting in an estimated loss of $5,500. The damage was promptly addressed, and the restoration was completed by July 20, 2023. Additionally, on August 15, 2023, a theft incident involving minor artworks occurred, with a loss valued at $3,000. Security measures were further enhanced post-incident. Both losses are categorized as resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $2,500 deductible.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class I, UL Listed Fire Safe, 2-hour fire rating, approved for storing art and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Robust security system with surveillance cameras and alarm monitoring, complemented by trained watchpersons during high-traffic events.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost, actual cash value for art inventory and supplies.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Artistry Haven does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The focus is on art and art supplies, with adherence to safety protocols for materials used.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Artistry Haven does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is primarily on promoting art and creative expression within the community.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the business owner's designated risk management personnel or through a third-party verification service.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Artistry Haven has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property. The business operates under strict ethical standards and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Artistry Haven has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. We have maintained consistent coverage without any issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Artistry Haven does not lease employees to or from other employers as all staff are directly employed by the business. This practice ensures consistent service and adherence to our operational standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Artistry Haven carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect our employees. Our active policy is in place prior to the effective date.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Artistry Haven operates another business, Artistry Haven Creative Spaces, LLC, which focuses on hosting art workshops and community engagement events.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Artistry Haven does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The current policy is the primary coverage for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Artistry Haven is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on retailing original artworks and art supplies without any manufacturing activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Artistry Haven does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our focus is exclusively on retailing artworks and art supplies. We prioritize maintaining the integrity of our inventory within the gallery and store.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Artistry Haven has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Artistry Haven does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, as it focuses solely on retailing art and art supplies while adhering to safety protocols for any materials used.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Artistry Haven does not have any catastrophe exposure as the business operations and inventory management practices are designed to minimize risk and adhere to safety protocols.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Artistry Haven has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a commitment to a safe and inclusive environment for all employees and patrons.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Artistry Haven currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and prioritizes compliance with all fire safety regulations. Regular inspections and maintenance ensure that our fire protection systems are in good working order.
